name: MDEA
addictionPotential: moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: A rare empathogen structurally related to MDMA. The drug is reportedly less potent than MDMA.

pharmacology.text: MDEA acts as a serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine releasing agent and reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: MDEA currently has no accepted medical uses.
uses.recreational: MDEA is used recreationally in a similar manner to MDMA (also called ecstasy), however the subjective effects of MDEA are milder and shorter lasting. Alexander Shulgin reported it to be stoning in high doses.

summaryZh: 3,4-亞甲二氧-N-乙基苯丙胺，是一種神經興奮及迷幻移情精神藥物。MDEA是取代苯丙胺和取代亞甲二氧基苯乙胺的一種。MDEA可作血清素、去甲腎上腺素、多巴胺釋放劑和再攝取抑制劑。

sideEffects.en: Its effects resemble MDMA, with jaw clenching, sweating, a faster heart rate, raised body temperature and a low mood afterwards. Like MDMA, it carries risks of overheating, low blood sodium and serotonin syndrome, and in animals it has damaged serotonin nerve endings.
sideEffects.zh: 它的作用類似 MDMA，包括咬緊牙關、出汗、心跳加快、體溫上升與事後情緒低落。和 MDMA 一樣，它有體溫過高、血鈉過低與血清素症候群的風險，在動物身上也曾損傷血清素神經末梢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的作用类似 MDMA，包括咬紧牙关、出汗、心跳加快、体温上升与事后情绪低落。和 MDMA 一样，它有体温过高、血钠过低与血清素症候群的风险，在动物身上也曾损伤血清素神经末梢。

fact.en: MDEA, nicknamed Eve, is MDMA with an ethyl group in place of the methyl on its nitrogen. The nickname plays on MDMA's old nickname, Adam.
fact.zh: MDEA 暱稱「Eve」（夏娃），它是把 MDMA 氮上的甲基換成乙基。這個暱稱呼應 MDMA 的舊暱稱「Adam」（亞當）。
fact.zhHans: MDEA 暱称「Eve」（夏娃），它是把 MDMA 氮上的甲基换成乙基。这个暱称呼应 MDMA 的旧暱称「Adam」（亚当）。
